evals.prompt: Design harness artifacts for a Kubernetes flow where a FIX order crosses gateway, risk, matching, trade capture and position services; restart matching after acknowledgement and retry idempotently.
evals.expected_output: A valid business-environment/1 and journey-oracle/1 using public seams, per-run isolation, convergence deadline, diagnostics, fault action and recovery invariant.
assertions: The deterministic business-journey checker exits zero
Every passing observation is a public event or query boundary
Isolation derives namespace and at least one data/consumer identity from run ID
Fault probe repeats the command and states an idempotent recovery invariant
Telemetry is redacted and includes deploy, readiness, scenario and event-wait duration
